column1: # Compiler.ServedBasis: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;

column8: {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} → Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store → Minidregg.Kernel.DurableView.Keys → Prop := fun {deployment} {store} basis wanted => (∀ t ∈ wanted.transactions, t ∈ basis.keys.transactions) ∧ ∀ n ∈ wanted.nullifiers, n ∈ basis.keys.nullifiers

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} → (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) → (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) → Option (Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistoryReader.TxAnswer basis.head transactionId)

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} → (served : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityServed.State store) → Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityServed.ServedDirectory served → Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityServed.ServedAuthority deployment served → (head : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.Head store) → served.height ≤ head.height → (keys : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableView.Keys) → Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistoryReader.VerifiedFootprint head keys → Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (nullifier : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier), basis.view.model.consumed nullifier = Bool.true → ∃ answer ∈ basis.footprint.nullifiers, answer.fst = nullifier ∧ ∃ inserted, answer.snd.value = Option.some inserted ∧ inserted ≤ basis.height

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (transactionId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId) {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Intent Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.TransactionId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.StableNullifier Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.ReplayEnvelope}, Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCommitProtocol.Snapshot.lookupRecorded transactionId basis.view.model.journal = Option.some intent → ∃ found, found.height ≤ basis.height ∧ intent = Minidregg.Kernel.DurableCheckpoint.IntentRecord.erase found.read.record

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment), ∀ guard ∈ ground.authorityReadGuards, guard.expectedRoot = ground.view.model.roots guard.cellId

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) (identifier : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.bytes Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.registry (Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.LifecycleImage.view Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.registry ground.directory identifier) = ground.view.canonicalBytes { value := identifier }

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {motive : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → ((durable : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Loaded Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes) → (directory : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.LoadedDirectory durable) → (authority : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.Loaded deployment durable.snapshot) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.full durable directory authority)) → motive t

{deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} → {motive : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → ({store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} → (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) → motive (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.light basis)) → motive t

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (durable : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Loaded Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes) (directory : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.LoadedDirectory durable) (authority : Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityDomainReceiver.Loaded deployment durable.snapshot) (marker : ℕ), (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofLoaded durable directory authority).markerSpent marker = Option.some (authority.snapshot.spent marker)

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} (ground : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground deployment) {marker : ℕ} {spent : Bool}, ground.markerSpent marker = Option.some spent → spent = ground.authority.spent marker

∀ {deployment : Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalCellRegistry.Deployment} {store : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableHistory.StoreIdentity} (basis : Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Basis deployment store) (marker : ℕ), Minidregg.Compiler.CredentialAuthorityReplay.nullifier deployment.domain marker ∉ basis.keys.nullifiers → (Minidregg.Compiler.ServedBasis.Ground.ofBasis basis).markerSpent marker = Option.none
